title: 공증사무 이의신청사건의 처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Receipt of Written Objection)
(1) Where a client or interested person submits a written objection, the chief prosecutor of a district prosecutors' office shall receive it separately from criminal, petition, or internal investigation cases, and assign it to the prosecutor in charge of supervision (hereinafter referred to as the "prosecutor in charge") for handling.
(2) When a written objection is received, the employee in charge of notarial affairs at the district prosecutors' office shall prepare and manage the Register of Receipt and Handling of Objection Cases concerning Notarial Affairs in the attached Form, and records of objection cases shall be managed separately from records of criminal, petition, and internal investigation cases.
(3) Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall apply mutatis mutandis to cases where the Minister of Justice receives a written objection from a client or interested person and transfers it to the chief prosecutor of the district prosecutors' office having jurisdiction over the notary public concerned. <Amended on February 7, 2022>
